scoring: Three exact JSON-value comparisons against frozen oracles; root independently recomputed all oracles after answers arrived.

arms.caveat: Observation timestamps bound dispatch-to-result observation only; result arrival was not independently timestamped. Effective identities and per-agent usage are unknown.

policy_decision: Do not change registry ranks or generic defaults. This pilot establishes only first-pass correctness on three bounded examples under requested configurations.
scope_evidence: Workers reported reasoning from declared inputs without solver/oracle reads, writes, network or delegation. This self-report is not independent authentication of all actions.
limitations: One run per arm, three deterministic cases: no statistical or broad model-quality conclusion.
Task-name-only spawn results establish accepted request IDs, not effective model/effort.
Reported timestamps are observation bounds, not inference-latency measurements.
No per-agent token/credit usage was exposed; no subscription-cost or API-cost inference.
